question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Clamour
solution:
The correct answer is **'Quiet'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Clamour **is a noun which means a loud and confused noise, especially that of people shouting.

 
 
• Example - *The questions rose to a **clamour**.*
 
 
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Quiet </
